content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice
content_blocks.text: You are hereby notified that you have failed to comply with the terms of your lease agreement, specifically the requirement to pay rent on time.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Deadline
content_blocks.text: You are required to vacate the premises located at 789 Maple Lane, Riverdale Town, State of Novaria, within thirty (30) days from the date of this notice.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Consequences
content_blocks.text: If you fail to vacate the premises within the aforementioned period, legal action may be initiated against you to recover possession of the property.
